data.narrative:
Kelluu is a Series A frontier-tech company in Defense & Security that has raised €20M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comparables universe of 10 peers at the same or adjacent stage within Defense & Security, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Singularity, and NODA AI.

The peer-median method serves as the primary triangulation approach. The 10-company cohort exhibits valuations ranging from $125M to $3.0B, with a median of $1.0B. Named peers in this set include Dream Security at $3.0B (Series B), Harmattan AI at $1.4B (Series B), Code Metal at $1.2B (Series B), and both Castelion and Defense Unicorns at $1.0B (Series B). This method implies a $1.0B valuation for Kelluu, consistent with later-stage comparables and reflective of sector-wide capital intensity and defensibility requirements.

The triangulated range is $850M to $1.1B, with a median of $1.0B. This relatively tight band reflects the homogeneity of the peer set but also acknowledges that only one valuation method was applicable to the available data. Key uncertainties include Kelluu's specific revenue run-rate, go-to-market traction relative to named peers, and customer concentration—factors that would refine positioning within this range. A full assessment would benefit from additional revenue or growth-multiple triangulation once operational metrics are disclosed.
